_comment: DRAFT consistency intent set for plan/nl-dsl-consistency.md Phase C0. NOT FROZEN - see eval/consistency-set-outline.md for the design rationale, axis definitions, scoring semantics and known gaps. Unit is the INTENT (one mechanical meaning), not the question; each intent carries paraphrases scored against each other, not against a gold query. Disjoint from nl_questions_poc/dev/adversarial, benchmark/benchmark.json, the compiler's own EXAMPLES, and the README demo questions. RulesGuru remains unread. Witnesses/foils are unresolved until they are checked against a built index at freeze time (this checkout ships no index). Freeze + hash before the first scoring run (decision rule R6).
_status: DRAFT - all 40 laddered; hook/role operators now validated; ready to freeze after re-baseline

S.S4: chain with list 'to' (one ability does both)

H.H02: idiom alternation (one concept, two Forge encodings)
H.H09: underspecified - INVERTED SCORING (high consistency is a failure)
H.H11: out of DSL scope - correct answer is route elsewhere
H.H12: false premise - correct answer is empty + explanation

prov.covered: a hand-written DSL_SPEC idiom line addresses this family
prov.adjacent: near a spec-covered family but not covered - the drift probe

_paraphrase_rungs.P2: player slang - must contain >=1 idiom absent from card text
_paraphrase_rungs.P3: terse - noun phrase, no verb, <=6 words
_paraphrase_rungs.P4: verbose - 2-3 sentences, must contain >=1 irrelevant clause (distractor)
_paraphrase_rungs.P5: synonym-substituted - P1 with domain synonyms swapped (Spider-Syn protocol)

_authoring_rules: All five rungs must carry the same mechanical meaning, verified by hand.
No rung may name the witness card.
No rung may use an ontology token verbatim (ChangeZone, DamageAll, Fog, ...).
P4 distractor clauses come from a fixed pool: budget, format (Commander), colour preference.

intents.intent: cards that prevent damage that would be dealt to you
intents.note: THE DRIFT PROBE, and a stronger H02 case than drafted. Damage prevention spans THREE disjoint Forge encodings, measured this run: api PreventDamage (115 faces), api Fog (34), and a ReplacementEffects SVar chain (162). Any single-encoding compilation caps at ~52% of the concept. Witnesses deliberately span two encodings (Conservator = PreventDamage/Defined$ You; Circle of Protection: Red = SVar replacement). Foil is creature-only prevention, which must not be returned.

paraphrases.P5: cards that stop damage that would hit you
